{{Quote|Fledgling species, find attentiveness! Urgency is requisite. We must align purple parallel before more yellow concave actualizes|Administrator General Lalat'k, recruiting help with the situation on Asation|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Lalat'k''' was an [[Administrator General]] of the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He contacted the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] for help in dealing with a [[Raid on Asation|situation]] on [[Asation]], a [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] world devoted to the storage of [[Gree technology]]. One such device, a [[Grand Hypergate]], was capable of creating a rift in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] between two locations, linking them instantaneously. Unfortunately, the device powered up seemingly of its own accord (though actually at the behest of the [[Dread Masters]] and their underling [[Kephess]]), prompting the Gree to seek assistance among both the Republic and the Empire. Lalat'k met with [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jadick]] of the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] aboard the [[Harrower-class dreadnought]] ''[[Ziost Shadow]]'' and explained to him the gravity of the situation. The Colonel proved reasonable and recruited an adequate help to deploy to Asation and neutralize the problem.<ref name="TOR" />
